description: Space surface registry: one row per route, event subject, index, cache key family, notification type and preview, with its ZDR class. Authored by hand and by the workstream that adds the surface (same PR); pinned by space-surface.v1.json.sha256 and scripts/tests/zdr-contract-sync.test.sh. Completeness lints: model-gateway zdr_posture (every non-GET route), gateway tests/space_routes_zdr_classes.rs (every /api/v1/spaces route).

zdr_classes.refuse: the surface refuses a ZDR caller or a ZDR-flagged Space with the typed catalogue code
zdr_classes.refs_only: the surface keeps ids and timestamps only under ZDR, never content
zdr_classes.poll_only: no push under ZDR; the caller polls
zdr_classes.local_only: state stays on the client or in memory and is never persisted
zdr_classes.n/a: stores no content (configuration, reads, deletes, ephemeral compute)

route_classes.ReadMetadata: gateway reads ids, roles and labels from Control
route_classes.ModelRead: gateway reads Model Plane state under a Control read decision
route_classes.Config: configuration or access-list write: ids only, allowed under ZDR (K4-14)
route_classes.DurableWrite: durable content write: calls crate::zdr::org_zdr_lookup before minting a decision
route_classes.Chat: a chat turn through the gateway

basis_values.guard:<fn>: the handler calls the named ZDR guard
basis_values.posture-decided: the handler decides the ZDR posture per call
basis_values.path-rule: classified by what the route does, no guard needed
basis_values.registry: classified here; the gateway has no runtime ZDR guard on the route yet
basis_values.unreviewed: no guard found, classified n/a pending review

rows.reason: Cancels one of the caller's own pending reminders: removes data, so it is allowed under ZDR; another member's reminder answers like a missing one.
Revoke a binding; allowed under every posture.
Revokes a standing approval rule through Control (its creator or a manager or owner); a deletion of a rule that holds ids, keys and levels, never content, so it is allowed under every posture.
Revocation is allowed under every posture.

Deletes one room file after proving the caller can read it under their own Control retrieval decision; a delete persists nothing, so the handler has no ZDR refusal and documents-api's owner check decides who may.
Shows a hidden DM in the caller's own sidebar again by removing a presentation row of ids; a removal, allowed under every posture.
Access list change; removal allowed under every posture.
Deletes are allowed under every posture
Unpins one post by removing a row of ids; a removal, allowed under every posture, and it skips the read proof so a pin on an archived thread stays removable.
Deletes one message (a tombstone for every reader): refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 or 503 before any Control or model call, like an edit; the Idempotency-Key header is required.
Removes the caller's own reaction (ids, an emoji and a time): an erase, so it is allowed under ZDR and needs only an active membership.
Org agent installations (ids, labels).
Lists the caller's Spaces (ids and labels).

Cross-room attention aggregate (counts, ids and timestamps) from Application, Control read decisions and Session Core; the handler reads the org posture per call and a ZDR or unknown posture answers mode zdr_empty with no upstream call.

Lists the caller's own inbox rows (ids, a closed kind word, timestamps); a ZDR or unknown posture mints no read decision and calls no Session Core, so rows stay refs-only (mode zdr_refs_only) with restricted titles and no live approvals.
Erasure receipt read.
Reports the shell-level rollout flags where no Space is in scope; it reads no upstream and stores nothing.
Lists the caller's own pending reminders (ids, a closed state word, timestamps); there is no note field, so no content is read.

Reads the member's personal sidebar layout (refs and labels): a ZDR or request-flagged caller is answered mode zdr_local with no document and the SPA keeps its own copy in the browser; an org-core outage is a 503.

Reads the caller's own status in their organization: text is returned only when the org posture is a confirmed not-ZDR (unknown fails closed), so under ZDR only the closed state word and expiry come back.
Action catalog for the Space.
Activity read (runs, approvals, receipts).
Agents bound to the Space.
Installable agents for the Space.
Control's list of standing approval rules (ids, keys and levels), relayed under the caller's delegation; Control requires a manager or owner and the route holds no content.
Control's Space approval ceiling (a level word and a revision), relayed under the caller's delegation to any readable member; no content is read or stored.
Read of artifact summaries, never content. A ZDR org gets an empty list and retention.zdr = true; an org-core outage reads as null, not as a posture.
Space context (ids, role, entitlements).
Resolves a message address to its thread under a fresh Control read decision; a read, so a ZDR caller may resolve it, and nothing is stored (the answer is no-store).
A ZDR org (or an org-core outage) gets one connected frame with mode poll_only and a closing zdr_poll_only, never a push stream; the caller polls.
Lists the room's files (ids, names, sizes) from Data Plane under a Control retrieval decision; a read that stores nothing and is answered no-store.
Reads back the caller's own room-file upload job from Ingestion (file names, a status and counts); a read that stores nothing, and a ZDR org cannot start an upload to read back.
Reads one room file's extracted text through retrieval-engine under the caller's own Control retrieval decision; a read that stores nothing, text only and answered no-store.
Space-layer instructions read (any active member).
Space sources from Retrieval under a retrieval decision.
Current Control membership fact.
Space memory list under a Control model.space.memory.manage decision; a ZDR caller is answered empty by Session Core (EP-8 S7).
Reads the caller's own notification level and hide_preview flag for one room (a closed word and a boolean) after live membership is confirmed with Control; no content.
Members and agents (ids, roles).

The member live view of a run (SSE): the handler checks the request and org ZDR posture before any Control call and refuses a ZDR caller with the typed 403 zdr_feature_not_supported (an unknown posture is 503), because the room live view has no zero-retention form.
Thread list from Model Plane under a read decision.
Reads the caller's own follow state of one thread (following, muted, none) after live membership is confirmed with Control; no content.
Transcript read under a read decision.
One window of the room's posts from Session Core through model-gateway under a fresh Control read decision per page; a read that stores nothing and has no ZDR branch.
Control's stored per-tool policy (Space ceiling, agent layers, merged view): tool keys and levels, never content; any member who can read the Space may read it.
Runs, schedules and processes under a read decision.
Room name and topic are room configuration labels, not conversation content; allowed under ZDR like room creation (K4-14). The room admin tests pin that no Model Plane call is made.
Pause or resume a binding (state flag).

Sets who may wake one bound agent (members, managers or an allowlist of subject ids): ids and a mode word with no content, so ZDR orgs behave the same; an owner or manager decided from Control's live role.
Authored instruction text is stored content: refused for a ZDR org before any Control call (typed 412).
Role change: ids and roles only, allowed under ZDR (K4-14). Granting or changing manager or owner needs an owner.

Sets a room's visibility, self-join role and history window: ids and closed words with no content, allowed under ZDR; Control applies the role rule (owner only for history_mode, owner or manager otherwise).
Edits one message of free text: refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 or 503 before any Control or model call; Control's revise decision binds the digest of the new text.
Retitles a thread: the title and preview are refused for a ZDR token in Session Core (typed 412); a pin or persona change stays allowed.
Creates a personal Space record in Control (ids, no content).
Marks one of the caller's own inbox rows done, open or snoozed: a closed state word and a snooze timestamp on a row of ids, so ZDR does not change it.

Advances the caller's own read markers and resolves their own mention and reply rows in rooms taken from Control's index: ids and timestamps only, the same marker write a room visit makes, so ZDR does not change it.

Opens or returns the DM for a fixed set of people, which persists message content: refused for a ZDR or unknown-posture org with the typed 412 or 503 before any Control or Application call; Control's dm-eligibility pre-check then decides who may be added.
Ensures the organization room exists (ids, no content).
Agent registry entry (configuration, ids only, K4-14).
Personal-agent admission (configuration, ids only, K4-14).

A member's decision on a Space approval. The free-text reason is refused first for a zero-retention caller (durable_write_refusal), before any Session Core call; the route and spaces.decide_approval share this body.

Room archive state: ids and a timestamp only, allowed under ZDR like room details (K4-14). Control applies the manager-or-owner rule and refuses the organization room; the room admin tests pin that no Model Plane call is made. An archived room still reads and refuses writes.
Grant create is a durable write (plan 1.3 #8): refused for a ZDR org before any Control decision. A revoke is allowed under every posture.
Erasure request; allowed under every posture.

Streams a room-file upload to Ingestion, which persists the file: refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 (surface room_files) before any Control or Ingestion call; Control's import decision needs an editor or above.
Hides one DM in the caller's own sidebar: ids and a time only, never content, so it is allowed under ZDR; a post in the DM clears the hide.
The caller joins an open room of their organization through Control's actor-carrying writer: an access-list change (ids and a role) with no content, allowed under ZDR; the gateway checks no role.
Access list change (ids only, K4-14).
Presence beacon: ids and timestamps only.
Read marker: ids and timestamps only.

Creating a reminder is a durable write (ids, a closed state word and timestamps; no note field): refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 after the live-membership check and before the Application call.

A manager's Stop writes a durable cancel receipt on someone else's run: refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 or 503 before any Control call; Control's run-control decision needs a manager or owner.
Permission-checked message search carried over POST so the query stays out of the URL; a read, so a ZDR caller may search, and nothing derived from the query is cached, stored or logged.
A member's post is stored free text under their name: refused for a ZDR org before any Control or model call (typed 412).
A member's reply is stored free text under their name: refused for a ZDR org before any Control or model call (typed 412).
Restores an archived room: ids and a timestamp only, allowed under ZDR (K4-14). Control applies the manager-or-owner rule; a lifecycle replay never unarchives.
Moves the caller's own read marker backwards for one room: a marker row of ids and a timestamp, no content, so ZDR does not change it.
Saves the personal sidebar document, whose labels are user-authored text: refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 before any Application call; compare-and-set on a revision.

A status text is stored free text: a write that carries text is refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 before any Application call, while a state-only write (closed vocabulary, optional expiry) stays allowed.

Replaces one agent's tool-policy layer on Control (tool keys and levels, never content; a policy only tightens) and projects the revision onto the binding; a manager or owner, compare-and-set on expected_revision.
Sets the caller's own notification level (all, mentions, off) and hide_preview boolean for one room: a closed vocabulary and no content, so it is allowed under ZDR.
Pins one post for the room: stores ids and a timestamp only (no title or content), so a ZDR org has nothing to withhold; the live role must be editor or above.
Setting a thread follow writes a durable row and is refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 before any Application call; setting state none clears the row and is always allowed.

Adding a reaction persists a new row about the room (ids, an emoji and a time): refused for a ZDR org with the typed 412 or 503 before any Control, model or Application call; the live role must be editor or above.
Replaces the Space tool-policy ceiling on Control (tool keys and levels, never content; a policy only tightens); a manager or owner, compare-and-set on expected_revision.
